thread:
emma: @auditor_bot hello — we got your request around RBAC mappings + KMS rotation evidence. putting thread to track.

raj: can you paste the exact control IDs you need? SOC2/ISO labels differ.

auditor_bot: Auditor request: Please provide mapping for access_control (CC6), key_management (KM1), audit_logging (AL2). Also export of KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt events and CloudTrail logs for key id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd for last 12 months. CSV preferred.

matthew: noted. plan: 1) RBAC mapping tile (role->policy->control IDs) 2) CloudTrail export for kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt 3) SIEM search + splunk saved search + sample artifacts 4) Instructions/playback doc showing chain of custody.

emma: quick Q — do they need per-user principal list for service accounts? or only role bindings?

auditor_bot: Per-user + service accounts for high privilege roles (admin, infra, deploy). Also timestamps of role changes + who performed them.

raj: ok, we can pull rolebinding history from k8s audit logs and iam change logs. will take me ~2d to compile. I'll attach commands below.

raj: ```
# k8s audit export
kubectl get events -n kube-system --field-selector involvedObject.kind=RoleBinding -o json > /tmp/rolebinding-events.json
# aws iam change history (example window)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=UpdateRole --start-time 2025-03-01 --end-time 2026-03-01 > /tmp/iam-update-role.json
```

matthew: for KMS rotation logs we use CloudTrail + key policy history. here's the splunk query we'll hand off: 

matthew: ```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt) AND requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd"
| stats count by userIdentity.principalId, eventName, awsRegion
```

emma: packaging: we'll create an evidence bundle in s3: s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2-2026-03/evidence_bundle_v1.zip with README.md explaining file provenance and hash.

sre_ops: FYI - need to rotate temporary audit export role before we share. i'll provision expiring creds and record the step in the playback.

raj: ETA: I'll have raw exports + mapping csv by EOD Fri. matthew: can you produce the Splunk snapshots and the README skeleton?

matthew: yep, I'll drop snapshots and saved-search links. also adding a small replay script to reproduce the CloudTrail export.

emma: next steps: 
- raj: produce role->principal->control csv (include change timestamps)
- matthew: splunk snapshots + CloudTrail export script
- sre_ops: temporary role + credential rotation steps
- emma: assemble zip, compute sha256, upload to s3 and provide presigned link

auditor_bot: Auditor preference: deliver via secure SFTP or presigned S3 with 7-day expiry. Also need signed statement confirming no evidence tampering since export.

emma: we will add a signed statement. drafting now.

raj: quick technical note: some KMS events older than 365 days may be archived; CloudTrail retention is 13 months by default — we have everything for last 12 months.

matthew: also flagging that Decrypt events for envelope keys include userIds only when used by principal; service internal decrypts show service principal. we'll annotate in README.

sre_ops: putting blocker — we need approvals for sharing service-account lists with auditors. people-ops already looped in.

emma: thanks. @people-ops please ack the data share for service-account principals.

people-ops: ack'd. we approve the minimal list share for audit purposes only. :white_check_mark: 

emma: great — I'll update thread when bundle is uploaded. targeting Monday delivery.

matthew: small sample attached (base64) -> not the actual data but proof of format :slightly_smiling_face: 

emma: thanks all. closing the loop once S3 link posted.
